newsitem.title: CHINA: China gives no interbank market rates (CHIBOR).
newsitem.headline: China gives no interbank market rates (CHIBOR).

text.p: The official Xinhua news agency on Monday did not issue the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) on Monday for technical reasons.
Xinhua staff said that they could not read clearly the figures faxed to them and were later unable to reach banking officials responsible to obtain the numbers.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates. Here are the figures for Friday, the previous trading day.
